description: If behind NAT and need to know the public IP of your internet gateway.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: URL of the ipify.org API service. ?format=json is appended by default. Default: "https://api.ipify.org/"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: HTTP connection timeout in seconds. Default: 10

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates are not validated. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Gather IP facts from ipify.org
- name: Get my public IP
  community.general.ipify_facts:

# Gather IP facts from your own ipify service endpoint with a custom timeout
- name: Get my public IP
  community.general.ipify_facts:
    api_url: http://api.example.com/ipify
    timeout: 20

return_values.name: ipify_public_ip
return_values.description: Public IP of the internet gateway. Returned: success Sample: "1.2.3.4"
